catalogue_entries.exact_retained_statement: Does a Presburger group P with SC(P)=Σ4 exist?
catalogue_entries.original_source_title: Jason Block: Measuring the Complexity of Countable Presburger Models
catalogue_entries.historical_handoff_status: No exact closure in the supplied catalog-ledger snapshot.
catalogue_entries.headline: Explicit countable Presburger group with a Σ₄ Scott sentence and no Π₄ Scott sentence; hence optimal complexity Σ₄.
catalogue_entries.scope_note: This is the research report disposition; no external catalogue authority file was modified.
catalogue_entries.construction: Fix a positive transcendental t. Let W=Q[t]+span_Q{1/(t+n):n>=1}, ordered as a subgroup of R. Set P=W times Z lexicographically with distinguished 1=(0,1).
catalogue_entries.conclusion: SC(P)=Sigma_4 under the infinitary hierarchy and optimal-complexity convention in Block v3.
catalogue_entries.proof_summary: The proper elementary substructures P_n=((t+n)W) times Z contain every finite tuple for some n and are isomorphic to P by division of the first coordinate by t+n. Their isomorphisms move a=(1,0) outside its automorphism orbit. Sigma_1 absoluteness and Pi_2 downward preservation show that this orbit is not Sigma_3 definable, hence no Pi_4 Scott sentence exists. Naming a makes every tuple orbit Pi_1 definable by rational cuts and universal residue formulas, yielding a Pi_3 Scott sentence with a named and a Sigma_4 Scott sentence after existentially quantifying a.
dependencies: Presburger quantifier elimination in the congruence expansion
Montalban 2015 A robuster Scott rank Theorem 1.1; also Block v3 Theorem 1.1
catalogue_entries.effective_strengthening: A computable positive transcendental t can be chosen; canonical rational functions then give a computable presentation of P. This is proved by a construction in prose, not executed.
catalogue_entries.independent_audit: Separate written reviews by two other collaborators in this session; completed, without a proof-assistant kernel.
catalogue_entries.upper_bound: An explicit schematic Σ₄ Scott sentence is constructed in Section 6.1 of the proof.
catalogue_entries.lower_bound: The orbit of a=(1,0) has no parameter-free Σ₃ infinitary definition; Montalbán’s orbit theorem excludes Π₄ Scott sentences.
